As collagen production slows, skin loses its structural integrity, leading to a “heavy” jawline and dullness. The NIR CellBright Facial isn’t a surface-level treatment; it is a targeted medical-grade light therapy designed to heat the deep dermis to the precise temperature required for collagen fibers to contract and rebuild. We restore the kind of luminous brightness that only comes from healthy skin structure.
Multi-Layer Rejuvenation

• Instant Tightening & Lift: Immediate contraction of sagging areas.
  • Luminous Texture: A refined surface that reflects light perfectly (The “Pearl Glow”).
  • Fairer, Even Skin Tone: Thermal circulation helps break down melanin deposits.
  • Pore Refinement: Plumps the skin to reduce the appearance of pores.
  • Cumulative Growth: Results peak at 2–4 weeks as new collagen matures.

blocks.text: How it Works: The Deep-Layer Lift
blocks.html: How it Works: The Deep-Layer Lift

Most facials only touch the surface. The Alma™ NIR (Near-Infrared) technology goes deeper. It uses light energy that safely bypasses the surface to heat the water within the dermis to a precise 39°C–42°C. This creates a comfortable “thermal hug” in the deeper layers where your collagen lives.
The Visible Result

• The 30-Minute Result: Immediate Snap-Back
    Your existing collagen fibers react to the warmth by tightening instantly—like a spring recoiling. You’ll walk out of the session with a visible lift and a noticeable “lit-from-within” brightness.
  • The 30-Day Result: Natural Plumping
    The warmth “wakes up” your skin’s natural repair system. Over the next few weeks, your body produces fresh collagen that naturally plumps the skin from the inside out, softening fine lines, refining pores and defining the jawline.
Effortless Results, Zero Damage

Because the NIR light safely bypasses the surface to work deep within the dermis, you get clinical-grade results without the clinical drawbacks:

  • No Needles: A completely non-invasive and pain-free experience.
  • Intact Surface: The top layer of your skin remains perfectly undisturbed.
  • Zero Downtime: Your skin looks better the moment you leave. Go straight from your facial to a dinner date with a fresh, healthy glow—no peeling or redness.

Jawline “Heaviness”

 Uneven skin tone or a lack of natural radiance.

Frequently Asked Questions

• Is it suitable for sensitive skin?

    Yes. Because NIR targets the deeper dermis without overheating the surface, it is exceptionally gentle.

  • How is this different from Laser or HIFU?

    Laser treatments typically resurface the skin (requiring downtime), while HIFU delivers high-intensity focused ultrasound (often painful). NIR is a pain-free alternative that focuses on bulk heating the dermis for a more comfortable, restorative experience.

  • How many sessions do I need?

    For specific concerns, we recommend an 8-session program. Start with 3 sessions spaced 3 weeks apart to align with your skin's natural 28-day cellular renewal cycle.

  • What does it feel like?

    A comfortable, relaxing warmth similar to a hot stone massage or basking in warm sunlight.

  • Is this suitable for men?

    Absolutely. It is excellent for tightening the jawline and refining larger pores in thicker male skin.
